title: Packaging from a micro enterprise: MSME 45-day clock and TDS threshold
story: Logistics replenishes VCI bags from a micro-enterprise supplier on a 30-day written agreement. This purchase pushes the supplier past Rs 50 lakh for the tax year, so TDS starts. Meanwhile an earlier invoice from the same supplier has been stuck in approvals and is already overdue under the MSMED Act.
learning_points: TDS on purchase of goods applies only to the amount above Rs 50 lakh per seller per tax year
MSMED Act s.15/16: payment due within the agreed term (max 45 days); compound interest at 3x the RBI Bank Rate if late
Income-tax Act 2025 s.37(2)(g) (old s.43B(h)): late MSE dues are deductible only when paid
Treasury prioritises statutory deadlines over cash-holding

requisition.request_text: October replenishment: 86000 VCI poly bags 600x900 mm, 50 micron. Need by 10 Oct 2026. Approx Rs 8.6 lakh.
